count: W=4 sparse window cycles, max(ceil(K/4)+1, ceil(COUT/16)*max(1, max_b nnz_b), COUT), summed over conv1-conv10 (predict_w4.window_cycles); fill and drain left out; conv1 and conv10 are the same in every layout
images: Set12 + BSD68, sigma 25, test_noise seed 0, host emulation of the original export
saving: 100 * (original - layout) / original; pooled over the summed counts of the images

C1.what: Set12 01.png, noise seed 0, one default_rng(42) in layer order (fit.py, PROTOCOL.md)

C3.what: Set12 01/02/03, noise seeds 0 and 1, per image, seed and layer default_rng(seed*1000 + layer number) (q1_gpu_deadline_suite.load_or_fit, Multi-start's data)

budget.multistart: greedy from the identity + 4 greedies from balanced random starts, 400 proposals each, best kept (q1_gpu_deadline_suite defaults: --greedy-steps 400 --restarts 4)
budget.counting: each start's first evaluation counted, as in q1_fair_budget.py
budget.seeds: fit_group: seed + fitted-layer index (conv2 -> 0); Multi-start: q1_gpu_deadline_suite --seed <seed> (its per-layer seeds from the layer index, conv2 -> 1)

methods_not_deployable: sense_rr, sense_snake, sense_lpt need the image's maps before the layer runs (run-time ranking hardware, not on this core); window_greedy_self is fitted on the test image; random_oracle is chosen per test image
multistart_selection: the published Multi-start was calibrated on Set12 01-03 and chosen for the board after its BSD68 results were seen (best of 6 methods); its 77-image figure is not used to choose anything here, but the choice of that method was made on BSD68

calibration_objective.what: sum over conv2-conv9 of the mean W=4 window cycles on the calibration windows

random_median.what: median over the 20 layouts of the pooled saving; per-image figures from the per-image median

random_oracle.what: best of the 20 layouts per test image (selected on the evaluation image)
